node.text:
This is insane. This is seriously ridiculous.
Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei was asked what a young person who just graduated from high school should do today.
His answer:
“AI can already do junior lawyer work. Junior financial analyst work. Junior consultant work. We can’t deny that it will also eliminate jobs, and possibly a lot of them.”
In a few minutes, he listed the jobs that will disappear first, and the skill that will keep you in the game.
His advice boils down to one sentence:
“Obviously, learn to use AI.”
People who start learning this year won’t compete with AI: they’ll be the ones directing AI.
All of the following are free. Start today:
1. Anthropic - Interactive prompt engineering tutorial: the fastest way to learn how to direct models. github.com/anthropics/pro…
2. Anthropic course: from your first prompt to managing agents. github.com/anthropics/cou…
3. Anthropic Cookbook: practical recipes you can copy today. github.com/anthropics/ant…
4. Microsoft - Generative AI for Beginners: 21 lessons, no degree required. github.com/microsoft/gene…
5. Microsoft - AI Agents for Beginners: build agents that do junior-level work for you. github.com/microsoft/ai-a…
6. Hugging Face - Agents Course: free and comes with a certificate, from zero to a complete setup. github.com/huggingface/ag…
7. Google Cloud - Generative AI: hands-on notebooks from Google. github.com/GoogleCloudPla…
8. OpenAI Cookbook: code for common tasks. github.com/openai/openai-…
9. DAIR.AI - Prompt engineering guide: the guide everyone is sharing. github.com/dair-ai/Prompt…
10. Andrej Karpathy - Neural Networks: Zero to Hero: understand the fundamentals. github.com/karpathy/nn-ze…
11. CrewAI: get your own team of AI employees up and running. github.com/crewAIInc/crew…
12. Microsoft - AutoGen: get multiple agents working together on the same task. github.com/microsoft/auto…
13. Awesome LLM Apps: hundreds of hands-on projects to learn from. github.com/Shubhamsaboo/a…
14. DeepLearning.AI - Short courses: free one-hour courses taught by subject-matter experts. deeplearning.ai/short-courses
15. Anthropic: AI Fluency with Claude imp.i384100.net/9Vyr33
16. Anthropic: AI Automation with Claude imp.i384100.net/E0RWXK
17. Anthropic: AI Collaboration with Claude imp.i384100.net/JkRaN2
18. Anthropic: Developing with the Claude API imp.i384100.net/n4WzQV
19. Anthropic Model Context Protocol: Advanced Topics imp.i384100.net/3km3Nr
20. Anthropic Teaches AI Fluency imp.i384100.net/R02X9X
21. Anthropic: Real-World AI Specialization for Everyone imp.i384100.net/AgBqn1
22. Claude AI for Marketing imp.i384100.net/enkbGz
23. Learn Claude from Scratch imp.i384100.net/AgRGD7
24. Claude Code: Software Engineering with Generative AI Agents imp.i384100.net/OeGoDn
Total cost: €0.
You don’t need another year of school to learn all this. What you need is to start telling AI what to do.
95% of people will finish school and then compete with AI for the same junior positions.
The 5% who learn to direct AI this year will manage the agents doing that work.
Save this post and share it with anyone graduating this year.
